title: Toward an Optimal Configuration for Tree Species Classification from Bark Images: A Leakage-Safe Ablation Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.05680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: The automatic identification of tree species from bark photographs is of practical interest for forestry inventory and the wood-processing industry, yet the design choices that govern the accuracy of deep-learning approaches have not been studied systematically, and some prior results may be inflated by leakage of images of the same trunk across training and test partitions. Methods: A systematic ablation study is conducted on the public BarkNet 1.0 dataset (20 species) under the established tree-level, leakage-safe partitioning scheme. Using ConvNeXt-V2 backbones, the following factors are varied in turn and evaluated by five-fold cross-validation: patch size, the strategy by which per-patch predictions are aggregated into an image-level decision, the training regime (single- versus two-stage), backbone capacity, the whole-image baseline, and the number of patches available at inference. translated_title: 面向树皮图像树种分类的最优配置探索：一项防泄漏消融研究
translated_abstract: 背景：通过树皮照片自动识别树种对林业清查和木材加工业具有实际意义，然而决定深度学习方法精度的设计选择尚未得到系统研究，且一些先前结果可能因同一棵树的图像同时出现在训练集与测试集中（数据泄漏）而被高估。方法：在公开的BarkNet 1.0数据集（20个树种）上，采用既定的树级别防泄漏划分方案开展系统性消融研究。基于ConvNeXt-V2骨干网络，依次改变以下因素并通过五折交叉验证进行评估：图像块大小、将逐块预测聚合为图像级决策的策略、训练方式（单阶段与两阶段）、骨干网络容量、整图基线以及推理时可用的图像块数量。结果：逐块精度上升……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究在树级别防泄漏的数据划分下，对基于树皮图像的树种深度分类进行了系统性消融实验，系统考察图像块大小、预测聚合策略、训练方式与骨干容量等因素，以确定最优模型配置并避免以往可能因数据泄漏而被高估的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a systematic, leakage-safe ablation study on bark-image tree species classification using BarkNet 1.0, examining patch size, prediction aggregation strategies, training regimes, and backbone capacity to identify an optimal deep-learning configuration while avoiding inflated accuracy from trunk-level data leakage.
